policy: Whole-suite (all non-live lanes) line and branch coverage per package, enforced on every CI run. Exact when no lane deferred a reviewed regression (push to main, nightly, full dispatch, and any pull request whose required profile deferred nothing). A required-profile pull request that deferred regressions may sit up to deferred_tolerance_points below a floor; the nightly full run still enforces it exactly. Floors only rise; update with tools/coverage_floor.py --write from a full run.
deferred_tolerance_basis: Largest observed deferral effect outside execution was 1.8 points (learning branch: PR run 40739549419 required profile 71.6% vs nightly run 45185381699 full profile 73.4%); floors sit one point below a full run.
deferred_tolerance_overrides_basis: No package has an override. execution had 4.0 because deferring the 21 legacy synthetic-journey functions cost it 3.9 branch and 2.6 line points, 70 of the 72 lost branches in execution/synthetic_journey.py (PR runs 45346056878 vs 45359015858). Plan 1.8 moved synthetic_journey.py, proposal_demo.py and proposal_certificate.py to devkit/, outside the measured src/panestria. The other 2 lost branches are 0.14 points of the 1464 execution branches left (main run 45469683932), so the 2.0 default covers the deferral; the full run still enforces the floor exactly.
measured_from: main d6035c1 push run 40656982993 (full profile) and PR #224 run 40657720203 (required profile); each floor is the lower measurement minus one point.
